- $t = range(2, 500)
- $d = range(2, 100)

#init:
- name = sample(names)
- p = sample(['કડાઈ', 'કુંડી', 'તવો'])

- $s = range(10, 31, 2)
- k_2_txt, k_2_val = range_str(2, 5, 1, numbers)
- k_3_txt, k_3_val = range_str(3, 8, 1, numbers)

- k_3_val > k_2_val
